## Tailoring Summary

PM-11 is `Required` at `Formal` rigor. The project has competing baseline and proposed-direction evidence, several stakeholder groups, a fixed launch deadline, restricted participant content, unresolved technical and privacy questions, and proposed features that may exceed the original replacement request. Requirements need source, rationale, priority, owner or approver, dependency, and testable outcome.

## Authority Boundary

This run may elicit, analyze, organize, and propose requirements. It may not approve the web-app platform change, commit new features to scope, assign owners, establish a baseline, or supersede existing decisions without explicit post-review PM approval.
